primitives.name: Per-Minute Scaling
primitives.verbatim_quote: In basketball, Dean Oliver and John Hollinger were early innovators who argued for evaluating players on a per-minute basis rather than a per-game basis and developed measures of overall player value, like Hollinger's Player Efficiency Rating (PER) (Oliver, 2004, Hollinger, 2005a,b).
